key_insight: HEM-Med separates transferable cross-hospital prescribing knowledge from hospital-specific patterns while adding safety-aware decoding to improve medication recommendations across multi-center settings.
clinical_relevance: The framework is designed to make medication recommendations more accurate, safer, and more adaptable to local formulary constraints in real-world hospitals.
method: Disentangled hierarchical memory to build patient-level medication context records
Splits memory into cross-hospital experience and hospital-specific residual knowledge
Safety-aware set generation with dual-level retrieval and safety-aware decoding
evidence_signal: The model was evaluated on a real-world multi-center eICU dataset and outperformed transfer learning, LLM-based, and other medication recommendation baselines on both accuracy and safety.
watch_item: Performance gains should still be validated prospectively, since local formulary rules, prescribing workflows, and safety constraints can vary across hospitals.
paper_title: HEM-Med: A Hierarchical Agentic Memory Framework for Safe Multi-Center Medication Recommendation
